# Divine Lab Worx

> Product launch, go-to-market and transformation consultants for Australian and international mandates, part of Sharktech Global.

Divine Lab Worx takes products, systems and facilities from concept to after-sales. The consultancy helps organisations enter markets, launch new offers, evaluate complex opportunities and grow from existing customers, assets, channels and capabilities. It is led by strategist Dainu Devis, operates as the consultancy arm of Sharktech Global and supports Australian and international mandates. Engagements combine strategy, mechanical engineering, workflow design, Concurrent Product and Process Design, go-to-market strategy and software under one accountable team.

## Primary capabilities
- Market-entry strategy: first customer, commercial case, beachhead segment and the evidence required before committing to a new geography or market
- Regulatory and compliance pathway: standards, approvals, registrations, claims and specialist coordination mapped into the commercial plan before launch
- Distribution and channel strategy: direct, distributor, reseller, retail and hybrid route-to-market design with partner economics and productive coverage
- Concurrent Product and Process Design: the offer, delivery process, compliance pathway and route to customer designed together
- Launch and demand generation: positioning, controlled pilots, conversion evidence and measured demand before national inventory and spend
- Capital-efficient growth: more revenue from existing customers, assets, channels, data and capabilities, including the Latent Growth Audit
- AI advisory and governance: readiness assessment, use-case prioritisation, business case, responsible controls and controlled implementation
- Strategy, transformation and feasibility: executive studies, stakeholder pathways, staged options and governed decision programmes
- Critical infrastructure site intelligence: power, planning, fibre, water, land and delivery pathway assessment for data centres, AI factories, semiconductor fabs and advanced cleanrooms

## Methodology
The DivineLab Concurrent Method develops strategy, the offer, operating process, delivery capability, economics and evidence together rather than in sequence. Five workstreams mature across six evidence gates, and each gate names the proof required before the next commercial commitment is released. The method applies concurrent product and process design principles to international market entry, product commercialisation, business transformation, critical infrastructure and applied AI.

## Industries
- Retail: new ranges, channel economics and more revenue from the customer base already earned
- Manufacturing: commercialising new equipment, asset utilisation and turning technical capability into demand
- Sustainable and 3D-printed homes: approvals, build systems, pilots, buyer confidence and repeatable delivery
- Critical infrastructure: site, stakeholder and delivery evidence for complex infrastructure investment
